_note: 유형별 묶음 구조. 같은 35번 지문이라도 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase 한다. order/insert/irrelevant/writing 은 구조상 예외. 원지문 유형(무관한 문장)을 특히 강하게.

passage: A range of case studies makes it clear that practicing digital minimalism can improve our mental health.
In a Stanford University study, people who cut back on social media and digital devices reported less stress, anxiety, and depression.
By dialing down the endless flow of information and notifications, they could focus on meaningful relationships and activities that supported their well-being.
In another case, a busy professional suffering from burnout and insomnia set firm limits on phone use and began practicing mindfulness.
As a result, he slept better, felt less stressed, and gained a new sense of calm and clarity.
choices: how social media platforms compete for users' limited attention
why insomnia has become so common among busy professionals
how universities design experiments to measure stress levels
why meaningful relationships matter more than career success
that reducing digital device use can improve people's mental health
theme.explanation_ko: 여러 사례 연구가 디지털 기기 사용을 줄이는 디지털 미니멀리즘이 스트레스·불안·우울을 낮추고 수면을 개선하는 등 정신 건강을 향상시킨다는 것을 보여 준다. ⑤가 주제로 정답.
theme.distractor_ko: ①플랫폼의 주의력 경쟁, ②불면증의 흔함, ③실험 설계, ④관계와 성공의 비교는 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: We should take seriously the evidence that digital minimalism benefits mental health.
A Stanford study found that limiting social media and devices lowered stress, anxiety, and depression.
With fewer notifications competing for attention, people focused on relationships and activities that nurtured well-being.
A burned-out professional who set phone limits and practiced mindfulness soon slept better and felt calmer.
So we should reduce our digital consumption to protect and improve our own mental health.
choices: 사회적 관계보다 개인의 성취를 우선시해야 한다.
정신 건강을 지키기 위해 디지털 기기 사용을 줄여야 한다.
대학 연구 결과는 신중하게 받아들여야 한다.
불면증은 반드시 전문가의 치료를 받아야 한다.
알림 기능은 업무 효율을 위해 꺼 두어서는 안 된다.
claim.explanation_ko: 디지털 미니멀리즘이 정신 건강을 개선한다는 근거에 따라 디지털 사용을 줄여야 한다는 주장. ②가 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ①성취 우선, ③연구 결과 수용 태도, ④불면증 치료, ⑤알림 유지는 핵심 주장이 아니다.

passage: Many case studies suggest that digital minimalism improves mental health.
In a Stanford study, limiting devices lowered participants' stress, anxiety, and depression.
With fewer notifications pulling at them, people poured their attention into well-being.
A burned-out professional who set phone limits and practiced mindfulness slept far better afterward.
In short, when we turn down the digital noise, our minds find room to breathe.
implication.underlined: our minds find room to breathe
choices: people need more physical exercise to clear their minds
fresh air is the main cure for stress and anxiety
the brain works best when it is kept constantly busy
we should breathe deeply whenever we use our phones
reducing digital distractions gives the mind space to recover and feel calmer
implication.explanation_ko: '우리의 마음이 숨 쉴 공간을 찾는다'는 디지털 소음을 줄이면 마음이 회복하고 더 차분해질 여유가 생긴다는 뜻이다. ⑤가 정답.
implication.distractor_ko: ①운동, ②맑은 공기, ③끊임없는 바쁨, ④휴대폰 사용 중 호흡은 밑줄의 의미와 다르다.

passage: It is evident through various case studies that adopting digital minimalism can lead to improved mental health.
A study conducted at Stanford University found that participants who limited their use of social media reported lower levels of stress.
By reduce the constant stream of information and notifications, individuals were able to focus on meaningful interactions.
In another case, a professional struggling with burnout and insomnia implemented digital minimalism techniques, such as setting boundaries for phone usage.
As a result, he experienced improved sleep, reduced stress, and a newfound sense of calm and clarity.
grammar.explanation_ko: ③ 전치사 'By' 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 하므로 동사원형 'reduce'가 아니라 'reducing'이 되어야 한다. 'By reducing the constant stream ~'이 옳다. ③이 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①동명사 주어 adopting, ②participants를 수식하는 주격 관계절 who limited, ④a professional을 수식하는 현재분사 struggling, ⑤명사 calm과 and로 병렬되는 명사 clarity는 모두 옳다.

passage: It is evident through various case studies that adopting digital minimalism can lead to worsened mental health.
A study at Stanford University found that participants who limited their use of social media reported lower levels of stress, anxiety, and depression.
By reducing the constant stream of notifications, individuals were able to focus on meaningful interactions that promoted well-being.
In another case, a professional struggling with burnout and insomnia set boundaries for phone usage and practiced mindfulness.
As a result, he experienced improved sleep quality, reduced stress levels, and a newfound sense of calm and clarity.
vocab.explanation_ko: ① 디지털 미니멀리즘을 실천하면 정신 건강이 좋아진다는 긍정적 흐름이므로, '악화된(worsened)'이 아니라 '향상된(improved)' 정신 건강으로 이어진다고 해야 한다. improved로 고쳐야 한다. ①이 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ②lower(더 낮은), ③promoted(촉진했다), ④boundaries(경계, 한계), ⑤improved(향상된)는 문맥에 적절하다.

passage: Case studies make it clear that adopting digital minimalism can lead to __________.
In a Stanford study, participants who limited social media reported lower stress, anxiety, and depression.
By cutting the constant stream of notifications, they focused on activities that promoted well-being.
A burned-out professional who set phone limits and practiced mindfulness soon slept better.
He came away with reduced stress and a new sense of calm and clarity.
blank.explanation_ko: 스트레스·불안·우울이 낮아지고 수면과 평정이 개선되었다는 사례들이 이어지므로, 디지털 미니멀리즘은 '향상된 정신 건강 결과(improved mental health outcomes)'로 이어진다. ⑤가 정답.
blank.distractor_ko: ①빠른 인터넷, ②소셜 미디어 인기, ③높은 스트레스, ④긴 근무 시간은 본문 흐름과 반대이거나 무관하다.

irrelevant.intro: It is evident through various case studies that adopting digital minimalism can lead to improved mental health outcomes.
sentences: For instance, a Stanford University study found that participants who limited their use of social media and digital devices reported lower levels of stress, anxiety, and depression.
By reducing the constant stream of information and notifications, individuals were able to focus more on meaningful interactions and activities that promoted well-being.
Additionally, participants reported relying on social media to get information for their purchasing decisions.
In another case, a corporate professional struggling with burnout and insomnia implemented digital minimalism techniques, such as setting boundaries for phone usage and practicing mindfulness.
As a result, he experienced improved sleep quality, reduced stress levels, and a newfound sense of calm and clarity.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: 글은 '디지털 사용을 줄이면 정신 건강이 개선된다'는 흐름인데 ③ '참가자들이 구매 결정을 위해 소셜 미디어에 의존했다고 보고했다'는 정신 건강 개선과 무관한 구매 행동에 관한 내용이다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②④⑤는 모두 디지털 사용을 줄여 스트레스·불안·우울을 낮추고 수면을 개선한다는 주제로 연결되지만, ③만 구매 의사결정이라는 다른 주제로 벗어난다.

order.given: It is evident through various case studies that adopting digital minimalism can lead to improved mental health outcomes.

blocks.A: By reducing the constant stream of information and notifications, these individuals were able to focus on meaningful interactions and activities that promoted well-being.
blocks.B: For instance, a Stanford University study found that participants who limited their use of social media and devices reported lower levels of stress, anxiety, and depression.
blocks.C: In another case, a professional struggling with burnout and insomnia set boundaries for phone usage and practiced mindfulness, and as a result slept better and felt calmer.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 일반 진술 뒤에 (B)가 'For instance'로 Stanford 사례를 제시, (A)가 그 효과(주의력을 well-being에 집중)를 설명, (C)가 'In another case'로 또 다른 사례를 더한다. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 'these individuals'는 (B)의 참가자들을 받으므로 (B) 뒤라야 하고, (C)의 'In another case'는 앞선 사례 뒤라야 한다.

insert.distractor_ko: 주어진 문장이 없으면 Stanford 사례에서 스트레스가 낮아진 '이유(알림 감소)'가 빠진 채 다음 사례로 넘어간다.

summary.summary_template: Case studies suggest that __(A)__ the use of digital devices can __(B)__ mental health, lowering stress and improving sleep.
summary.explanation_ko: 디지털 기기 사용을 (A)reducing(줄이는) 것이 스트레스를 낮추고 수면을 개선하며 정신 건강을 (B)improve(향상)시킨다. ⑤.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: A professional struggling with burnout set ___________ for phone usage and practiced mindfulness, and soon slept far better.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: As a result, he experienced improved sleep quality, reduced stress levels, and a newfound sense of calm and clarity.
writing.answer: 그 결과, 그는 향상된 수면의 질, 줄어든 스트레스 수준, 그리고 새롭게 찾은 평온함과 명료함의 감각을 경험했다.
writing.explanation_ko: As a result(그 결과), improved sleep quality(향상된 수면의 질), newfound(새롭게 찾은), calm and clarity(평온함과 명료함).
